claim.claim-text: 1. A seat adapter for mounting a child seat to a wagon, the seat adapter comprising:
2. The seat adapter of claim 1, further comprising a structural cross-member extending between the first and second adapter-to-wagon latch components to provide structural support to the wagon.

3. The seat adapter of claim 1, wherein the first vertical extension member extends between the first adapter-to-wagon component and the first adapter-to-seat component and the second vertical extension member extends between the second adapter-to-wagon component and the second adapter-to-seat component.

4. The seat adapter of claim 1, wherein the first adapter-to-wagon component is configured to removably couple to a first wall of the wagon, and wherein the second adapter-to-wagon component is configured to removably couple to a second wall of the wagon opposite the first wall.
5. The seat adapter of claim 1, wherein the first adapter-to-wagon component and second adapter-to-wagon latch component is manipulatable between locked and unlocked positions.

6. The seat adapter of claim 5, further comprising one or more actuators for actuating the first and second adapter-to-wagon components between a locked and an unlocked position relative to the wagon.

7. The seat adapter of claim 4, wherein the first adapter-to-wagon component and second adapter-to-wagon components includes are clamps that releasably engage a framer member of the first and second walls of the wagon.

8. The seat adapter of claim 1, wherein the first vertical extension member extends from the first adapter-to-seat component, and wherein the second vertical extension member extends from the second adapter-to-seat component.
9. The seat adapter of claim 1, wherein the first and second adapter-to-seat components are manipulable between locked and unlocked positions.
10. The seat adapter of claim 1, wherein the first and second adapter-to-seat components mate with a first and second latch components on the child seat.

11. The seat adapter of claim 1, further comprising an additional latch interference set comprising a first and a second latch component for removably mounting to the first and second adapter-to-seat components of the seat adapter, and a third and fourth latch component for removably attaching to the child seat.

12. The seat adapter of claim 2, wherein the cross-member extends from a lower side of the first and second adapter-to-wagon latch components downward into and across the wagon to provide the child seat to be mounted above it.
13. A method of mounting a child seat to a wagon, comprising: providing a seat adapter comprising:

14. The method of 13, wherein the seat adapter further comprises a structural cross-member extending between the first and second adapter-to-wagon latch components to provide structural support to the wagon.
15. The method of claim 13, further comprising coupling a child seat to the first adapter-to-seat component and the second adapter-to-wagon component.
